description: This Java source file defines the `ErrorResponse` class, which models error responses returned by the Fineract integration tests. It includes nested classes for detailed error information, methods for parsing error responses from HTTP responses, and uses external libraries such as Gson for JSON processing and Retrofit for HTTP responses.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Models the structure of error responses from the Fineract API, including fields for developer message, HTTP status code, and a list of errors.

classes.name: ErrorResponse.Error
classes.description: Represents individual error details within an ErrorResponse, including developer message and message arguments.

classes.name: ErrorResponse.ErrorMessageArg
classes.description: Represents arguments associated with an error message, holding a value of any object type.

methods.name: getSingleError
methods.description: Returns the single Error object if exactly one error exists; otherwise throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method that parses a Retrofit Response's error body to produce an ErrorResponse instance.
